definitions.gloss: different kind; different species; different type
definitions.explanation: Something of a different kind or category from what is being compared to. Used in both biological and general contexts.

examples.japanese: {異種|いしゅ}{格闘技|かくとうぎ}{戦|せん}が{話題|わだい}になった。
examples.english: The mixed martial arts match became a hot topic.

examples.japanese: {異種|いしゅ}の{金属|きんぞく}を{組|く}み{合|あ}わせて{使|つか}う。
examples.english: Different types of metals are combined for use.

examples.japanese: {異種|いしゅ}{間|かん}の{交配|こうはい}によって{新|あたら}しい{品種|ひんしゅ}が{生|う}まれることがある。
examples.english: New varieties can be created through cross-breeding between different species.

notes:
A compound of {異|い} (different, other) + {種|しゅ} (kind, species). Functions both as a standalone noun and as a prefix modifying other nouns.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {異種|いしゅ}{格闘技|かくとうぎ}: mixed martial arts (fights between different fighting styles)
- {異種|いしゅ}{間|かん}: between different species/types
- {異種|いしゅ}{混合|こんごう}: heterogeneous mixture
- {異種|いしゅ}{移植|いしょく}: xenotransplantation (transplant from a different species)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {同種|どうしゅ}: same kind/species — the opposite, indicating things of the same type
- {別種|べっしゅ}: another kind — similar meaning, but used more for classification
- {異質|いしつ}: heterogeneous, of a different nature — focuses on the quality or nature being different rather than the category
